rationale: Repair two inconsistent entries in the existing nearest-centroid head, leaving all other coefficients unchanged. Cluster 1 has the frequent-visitor/low-basket prototype, but its +2.90794 intercept creates a large unconditional bonus and swallows 615/960 support rows. Set that intercept to -||W_1/2||^2 = -3.3164059893080036, the exact analytic intercept for its unchanged prototype. Cluster 3 combines high annual spend, very few visits, and long recency with an impossible negative basket prototype (W_3,4/2=-2.214 standardized, about -100.5 USD, versus observed minimum 9.61 USD). Reverse only this standardized basket coefficient to +4.42806482315, restoring a roughly 235.6 USD large-basket prototype. The descriptive basket/visit histogram has 131 of 142 baskets above 140 USD at <=2 visits/month, confirming the sign. Keep the existing small-spend and online-dominant centroids, all remaining biases, and zero age weights. No optimization or iterative centroid updates; only sign diagnosis and the nearest-centroid norm identity.
